title: SentryHeat
description: Heat, damage bonus and kills for your sentries.

preview.label: Sentry Panel
preview.description: Drag the highlighted box to move the sentry panel (used when Style is the HUD table; shown with one sentry, each extra sentry adds a row). The other mods' HUD elements are shown faded.

Style.label: Style
Style.description:
World: data over each sentry.
Panel: number tags and a HUD table.

YellowAt.label: Yellow From
YellowAt.description: Heat % where the number turns yellow. The game's smoke starts at 80%.

RedAt.label: Red From
RedAt.description: Heat % where the number turns red.

StyleKey.label: Style Key
StyleKey.description: Switches the style until the next restart.

PanelX.label: Panel Position X
PanelX.description: Panel style: the table's right edge, as a fraction of the screen width.

PanelY.label: Panel Position Y
PanelY.description: Panel style: the table's vertical centre, as a fraction of the screen height.

NearDistance.label: Detail Distance
NearDistance.description: Closer than this (metres), a sentry shows its full panel.

MarkerHeight.label: Marker Height
MarkerHeight.description: How high above the sentry the marker sits (cm).

EdgeWarning.label: Off-Screen Warning
EdgeWarning.description: A red arrow at the screen edge when one of your off-screen sentries gets hot.

HideInMenus.label: Hide In Menus
HideInMenus.description: Hides the markers while a menu is open.

CappedColor.label: Max Bonus Color
CappedColor.description: The damage bonus at its +50% cap.

HeatColorLow.label: Heat Color: Low
HeatColorLow.description: The heat number below Yellow From.

HeatColorMid.label: Heat Color: Mid
HeatColorMid.description: The heat number from Yellow From to Red From.

HeatColorHigh.label: Heat Color: High
HeatColorHigh.description: The heat number from Red From.
